title: KUCCPS Reopens KMTC Applications, Giving Students Another Chance
desc: KUCCPS has reopened applications for selected KMTC programmes, giving eligible students another chance to join the September 2026 intake.
content:
Students seeking to join the Kenya Medical Training College have received another opportunity after the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service reopened applications for selected programmes ahead of the September 2026 intake.

The latest application window gives eligible candidates another chance to compete for available places, particularly those who missed an earlier opportunity or were unable to secure placement.

The reopening is significant for students hoping to pursue careers in Kenya's health sector, where KMTC remains one of the country's key training institutions for medical and health-related professionals.

For many young people and their families, missing an application deadline can delay education and career plans. A reopened window can therefore provide a fresh opportunity for candidates still seeking placement.

Reports published Monday indicate that selected diploma and certificate programmes are available under the latest application exercise, with applicants expected to use the KUCCPS student portal.

The opportunity also highlights the importance of students checking programme requirements carefully before submitting their choices. Different courses have different entry qualifications, meaning candidates should ensure their KCSE results meet the requirements for their preferred programmes.

Applicants should also confirm the availability of programmes and follow official KUCCPS instructions when submitting applications.

The development matters beyond the students applying today. Access to medical training helps prepare future health workers who may eventually serve communities across Kenya.

For families with students still searching for education opportunities, the reopened application window offers another pathway into professional training rather than waiting for a future intake.

The key message for eligible applicants is to act within the available application period and rely on official KUCCPS information when making their choices.

As the September 2026 intake approaches, the reopening gives students with an interest in medical and health-related careers another chance to secure a place in training.
